title: Shout Label
statement: Implement `solve(label, times, shout)`. `shout` is 1 or 0. If it is 1, uppercase `label`. Repeat that text `times` times and return the list of lines. `times` may be 0, which returns an empty list. Do not print.
hints: Choose the text once, then repeat it.
str.upper is the shout. Do not change label when shout is 0.
Return a list of length times.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: A tiny CLI decides the text, then decides how many times to emit it.

editorial: A tiny CLI decides the text, then decides how many times to emit it. Doing the uppercase inside the loop is the same result and extra work. Returning the lines lets a test assert them without capturing stdout.
